description: Discovers and streams the four official monthly IRS EO Business Master File regional CSVs, then publishes current-extract exempt-organization candidates with EINs, public names, filing addresses, tax-status classifications, ZIP/ZCTA context, provenance, exclusions, and explicit semantic limitations.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only the exact HTTPS EO BMF page and /pub/irs-soi/eo1.csv through eo4.csv paths on www.irs.gov.
retry: Retry only transient page or file acquisition failures. Do not retry schema, duplicate-EIN, source-count, source-date, checksum, or quality-gate failures without a new verified source snapshot.
checkpoint: All four complete source CSVs are retained and hashed before normalization; publication is run-scoped and current.json changes only after every quality gate passes.
idempotency: Source posting date plus the ordered SHA-256 checksums of eo1.csv through eo4.csv identify a source release; EIN creates a stable provisional organization candidate.
cancellation: Stop network and local streams cooperatively, close partition writers, leave unpublished run-scoped staging, and do not change current.json before complete publication.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal source CSVs and approved public normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
